speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: asked the Minister for National Development what measures are taken to ensure that industrial buildings are not subject to unauthorised modifications beyond the initial inspections.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: In addition, there is a monitoring regime in place for completed buildings.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: These onsite inspections have to be conducted by the Professional Engineers (PEs) engaged by the building owners.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Stern action will be taken against parties who are found to be involved in carrying out unauthorised works.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Members of the public can inform BCA if they come across any structures that they think are unauthorised.
